(See id. at 81 ("[t]he district court took into account the practical realities of the case, including the small size of the putative class and the plaintiffs' ability to proceed with the action.")).

(See id. at 1281 ("[t]he district court's approach was consistent with the approach taken in In re Volkswagen of America, Inc., in which the court required individualized evidence of each class member's identity.")).
